svg.aria-label: Drift trajectories in small and large populations, heterozygosity decay, and F-ST against migrants per generation
svg.text: Drift is sampling error, and its strength is set by N_e
The criterion is N_e s, not N_e or s
N_e|s| ≪ 1 → drift controls it — effectively neutral
The SAME mutation (s = 10⁻⁵) is purged in
E. coli (N_e s = 10³) and invisible in humans
One migrant per generation — regardless of population size

g.text: N_e m is the ABSOLUTE NUMBER of
migrants, not the rate — so an island
of a million needs the same single
migrant as an island of a hundred.
But it prevents drift-driven divergence only:
it can swamp local adaptation, and does
not by itself cure inbreeding depression.
